items.title: Reach more customers, close deals faster with new AI-powered capabilities in AWS Partner Central
items.summary: New AI-powered capabilities in AWS Partner Central and pre-built Skills in AWS Quick help you find the right customers, launch campaigns in minutes, and accelerate co-sell with AWS. With Partner Central Agents working alongside you, you spend less time on manual work and more time growing your business, right in the tools you already use.
items.creator: Sofia Calvo
